Additionally, any enemy is [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) while in the slime. > ⭐️ **Lethe** > > While the gunge is [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded), they gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on strikes, and any strike made against them gains an edge. > ⭐️ **Soulsight** > > Any creature within 2 squares of the gunge can't be hidden from them.
